content.short: Karak is a universal restaking network and L2 on Ethereum that supports a wide range of assets including stablecoins.
content.description:
Karak is a universal restaking protocol and EVM-compatible Layer 2 network on Ethereum, designed to provide pooled security for a new generation of decentralized applications. Unlike traditional restaking protocols, Karak allows users to restake a diverse array of assets beyond just ETH, including stablecoins, Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs), and wrapped assets like WBTC. This flexibility enables a more inclusive and robust security model for the projects built on top of the network.

Developers can leverage Karak's Distributed Secure Services (DSS) to launch protocols such as oracles, bridges, and sidechains without the need to build their own validator sets from scratch. By utilizing existing capital to secure new infrastructure, Karak significantly lowers the cost and complexity of launching decentralized services. As a foundational layer for pooled security, Karak is fostering a more efficient and interconnected ecosystem where users earn additional rewards for securing the future of the decentralized economy.
content.meta: Karak provides universal restaking and pooled security for a wide range of digital assets on Ethereum.
